detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Coordination Compounds (IUPAC Nomenclature of Secondary Amines):
N-Methylethanamine

Detailed Analysis:
In IUPAC nomenclature for secondary amines, the larger alkyl group (two carbons, ethane) forms the parent alkanamine chain (ethanamine), and the smaller group (methyl) is treated as an N-substituent. Hence, the systematic name is N-methylethanamine.

questionText: Which sequence correctly reflects the order of increasing field strength of ligands in the Spectrochemical Series according to NCERT?

options.text: $OH^- < F^- < Cl^- < Br^- < I^- < CO < CN^- < en < NH_3 < H_2O$

Hence, option (B) is correct.
